caption: The drawing features a single glass bottle with a stopper, rendered in blue and gold colors. The bottle has a wide, conical base that narrows into a tall, slender neck, flaring out slightly at the mouth. The stopper is spherical, painted in a deep blue with gold decorative accents resembling leaves or petals at the top. The neck of the bottle is adorned with two gold rings near the top and the bottom. On the body of the bottle, there is a gold illustration of a plant with leaves and branches, positioned as an accent on one side. The overall glass surface is mainly blue with white highlights to suggest light reflection and transparency. The background is plain light beige, with some small brownish marks near the top. The bottom right corner of the drawing has a blue signature that reads "Moss."
title: Bottle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
